abilities.description: Can distinguish the hand, age, and likely alterations in salt-etched genealogies and agreements.
abilities.name: Salt-script reading

abilities.description: Keeps her focus in the demanding conditions of the cathedral's public markets and crypts.
abilities.name: Pressure composure

characters.arc: Ilyra begins determined to secure her inheritance while keeping every doubt private. When a toll alters a crypt inscription during her attempt to verify it, she must choose whether to let the Cantors explain what they know in front of her rivals. She shares the evidence instead of hiding it, ending willing to challenge the Court's version of her claim even if the truth costs her the title.
characters.description: A disputed Vellum Court heir raised among the sealed ledgers of the Salt Crypt, Ilyra learned to read family standing in the spacing and cuts of salt-etched names. After a bell toll altered her descent in the crypt record, she became a liability to the court that had once prepared her to inherit. She wears a dark pressure suit fitted with narrow brass clasps and keeps her pale hair bound beneath a hood, leaving her face uncovered as a deliberate show of nerve.
characters.external_conflict: The Vellum Court needs her claim settled before the next toll, while the Giltwake Compact profits from financing both sides and the Drowned Cantors may know why the record shifted.
characters.flaw: She treats withholding information as the safest way to protect herself and others.
characters.goal: Prove her claim before the next toll changes the crypt record again, without making the Court's authority depend on suppressing the Cantors.
characters.internal_conflict: She wants recognition as the rightful heir but fears that accepting the title would make her complicit in the Court's manipulation of lineage.
characters.motivation: Discover whether the Salt Crypt records preserve a truth about her family or merely another version of a useful lie.
characters.name: Ilyra Vell

abilities.description: Can structure favors and loans so rival parties each believe they have the advantage.
abilities.name: Debt negotiation

abilities.description: Knows which trench routes and pressure-suited divers the Compact can safely provide.
abilities.name: Route knowledge

characters.arc: Orrin begins convinced he can manage the heir dispute by financing each faction and collecting favors when the bells toll. When Ilyra publicly shares evidence of the altered record, his usual private bargains lose their force. Faced with the choice to destroy his leverage or let the conflict deepen, he risks his standing by revealing the terms of his loans, ending with less control but no longer able to pretend that neutrality absolves him.
characters.description: A senior broker of the Giltwake Compact, Orrin arranges pressure-suited divers, safe passage, and loans for noble houses whose fortunes depend on the cathedral's records. He has made himself indispensable by lending to both branches contesting Ilyra's claim and collecting repayment in favors due at a bell toll. His immaculate gold-edged suit and polished ledger case make him look more like a courtier than a merchant, though he watches every conversation as if weighing collateral.
characters.external_conflict: Ilyra's search for an honest account and the Cantors' knowledge threaten to expose how the Compact benefits from the shifting crypt record.
characters.flaw: He assumes every conviction can be converted into a debt or a bargain.
characters.goal: Prevent any settlement of the disputed heir's claim from ending the Compact's profitable access to both sides.
characters.internal_conflict: He wants to believe his financial arrangements keep the city stable, but he knows his profit depends on prolonging uncertainty.
characters.motivation: Preserve the Compact's leverage over the Vellum Court and keep both claimants indebted.
characters.name: Orrin Gilt

abilities.description: Records bell patterns and relates them to changes in the trench currents and cathedral records.
abilities.name: Toll interpretation

abilities.description: Can notice shifts in the water around Choirwell that accompany the buried bells.
abilities.name: Current listening

characters.arc: Sere begins refusing to interpret the tolls for anyone outside the Cantors, believing silence prevents their rites from being bought. When Ilyra risks her claim by sharing the altered record openly, Sere must decide whether continued secrecy protects the city or merely protects the Cantors. They give Ilyra a careful account of what the toll revealed, ending willing to testify to its limits as well as its meaning.
characters.description: A masked interpreter of the Drowned Cantors, Sere records the patterns of the cathedral bells and listens for changes in the currents that answer them. They divide their time between the Salt Crypt, where they consult the altered names, and Choirwell Exchange, where traders mistake their listening for superstition. Beneath a slate-gray pressure suit, Sere wears a mask marked with fine, pale lines; their gloved hands carry a small slate on which they note each toll without claiming to know its full meaning.
characters.external_conflict: The Vellum Court blames the Cantors for the shifted lineage, while Orrin's financing gives him reason to keep their knowledge contested and exploitable.
characters.flaw: They withhold knowledge so completely that others are left to fill the silence with suspicion.
characters.goal: Explain what the bell tolls and the changed record can establish without exposing the bargain the city depends on.
characters.internal_conflict: They believe the tolls are warnings from the city itself, yet fear that explaining their own part in the bargain will turn the warnings into another commodity.
characters.motivation: Keep the Cantors' rites from being used as a tool of noble or merchant power.
characters.name: Sere Nacre

abilities.description: Presents genealogies and succession claims with practiced command of Vellum Court custom.
abilities.name: Court advocacy

characters.arc: Tavin begins treating the altered inscription as a convenient reason to displace Ilyra. When a bell toll changes another letter while he is present in the Salt Crypt, he must choose between concealing what he saw to secure his branch's advantage or admitting that the record cannot safely decide the succession alone. He acknowledges the alteration before the Court, ending prepared to compete with Ilyra openly rather than rely on a record he knows can change.
characters.description: A polished representative of a rival Vellum Court branch, Tavin grew up learning that a family's place in the Salt Crypt was both inheritance and proof of authority. He argues that the altered descent disqualifies Ilyra, though he privately doubts that one changed letter can settle a lineage. His formal dark coat is cut to fit beneath a pressure mantle, and a pale salt stain on one cuff hints at how often he visits the crypt despite his public certainty.
characters.external_conflict: Ilyra's claim threatens his branch, and any settlement must contend with the Salt Crypt's changeable records and the next bell toll.
characters.flaw: He confuses preserving order with preserving the truth.
characters.goal: Secure the succession for his branch while finding out whether the crypt's alteration can be explained without accusing the Cantors.
characters.internal_conflict: He envies Ilyra's claim to a place he wants for his family, but fears that winning through a disputed record would make his own authority hollow.
characters.motivation: Keep his branch from losing its standing and prevent the Court from appearing unable to defend its own records.
characters.name: Tavin Vell

relationships.description: Ilyra Vell distrusts Orrin Gilt because his Compact finances both sides of her succession dispute, while Orrin sees her determination to settle it as a threat to his leverage.
Ilyra Vell needs Sere Nacre's knowledge of the bells and the Salt Crypt, while Sere fears that helping her will expose the Cantors' hidden bargain.
Tavin Vell competes with Ilyra Vell for the Vellum Court succession and doubts her claim, but he knows the changing record may also undermine his branch.
Orrin Gilt has financed Tavin Vell's branch, making Tavin's pursuit of the succession partly dependent on the Compact's favors.
Sere Nacre resents Tavin Vell's branch for blaming the Cantors for the shifted lineage, while Tavin suspects Sere knows more about the toll than they admit.
